data.title: 埃塔 · 战服数据测量日
data.description: 埃塔穿着自己的史莱姆战服站在测量台上，任由助手们记录各项数据。百褶裙式的战服是她亲手改的设计——实用之外，也要一点点可爱。
data.location: laboratory fitting platform with measuring tapes, mirrors and data crystals
data.action: standing on a fitting platform in her pleated slime outfit while measurements are taken, bored sleepy expression
data.lighting: 测量室均匀的白色灯光
data.promptProse: On the fitting platform, Eta endures her own measurements. The pleated slime dress was her design — science can be cute.
data.animaCaption: Eta measures everyone else all year. Today the clipboard is pointed at her.
